by_districts.description: Per district (Kreis): people in security occupations (KldB 2010 main group 53) at their place of work, insured employees (workers_svb) and minijobs (workers_gb), 31 March 2026, from the Federal Employment Agency's 'Regionalreport über Beschäftigte' for each district; residents on 31 December 2024 from Destatis, Gemeindeverzeichnis (Kreisfreie Städte und Landkreise).
by_districts.title: Bavarian districts: workers

by_events.description: 33 Bavarian events with published visitor figures: football leagues 1–3 (diefalsche9.de, 2025/26), ice-hockey DEL main round 2025/26 (penny-del.org), Volksfeste (DSB Wirtschaftsstudie 2023; BAYERN TOURISMUS; festivalsindeutschland.de), Christmas markets Munich (city of Munich, 2025 estimate) and Nuremberg (2025), trade fairs bauma and IAA Mobility 2025 (GamesWirtschaft), Rock im Park and Summer Breeze.
by_events.title: Bavarian crowd events

by_shapes.description: Simplified outlines of the 96 Bavarian districts and 7 Regierungsbezirke, deutschlandGeoJSON (isellsoap, GitHub), based on DIVA-GIS data (pre-2021 boundary vintage; Bavarian districts unchanged).
by_shapes.title: Bavarian boundaries

events.description: 118 recurring crowd events with published visitor figures, compiled from public sources named in the 'source' column: football leagues 1–3 season 2025/26 (diefalsche9.de averages × home games), the 30 largest Volksfeste (Deutscher Schaustellerbund Wirtschaftsstudie 2023, Tab. 5), city festivals reported above 1 million visits, the largest trade fairs of 2025 (GamesWirtschaft) and the ten largest music festivals (top-10-liste.de). Coordinates are the venue location, checked to lie inside the stated state.
events.title: Large crowd events

population.description: Population on 31 December 2025 by federal state, from Destatis table 'Bevölkerung nach Nationalität und Bundesländern' (census-based, Zensus 2022).
population.title: Residents by state

security_staff.description: Workers in WZ 2008 class 80.1 'Private Wach- und Sicherheitsdienste' by place of work, 31 March 2026: svb_801 = employees subject to social insurance, gb_801 = marginally employed (minijobs). From Statistik der Bundesagentur für Arbeit, 'Beschäftigte nach Wirtschaftszweigen (WZ 2008) – Länder (Quartalszahlen)', tables SVB I and GB I.
security_staff.title: Security workers by state

state_shapes.description: Simplified outlines of the 16 federal states (deutschlandGeoJSON by isellsoap on GitHub, 'niedrig' quality, based on DIVA-GIS data), coordinates rounded to 3 decimals. Used only to draw the map.
state_shapes.title: State boundaries
